name: 1000 lb AP Bomb Mk 33
notes: Armour-piercing bomb for dive bombers. Muzzle velocity is zero because it has none: a bomb arrives at whatever speed the dive and the fall gave it, which is why release altitude decides what it can penetrate. The high De Marre K reflects a thin-walled bomb body, which is a far worse penetrator than a shell of the same weight.
